 Kevin O'Connor is joined by Amin Elhassan to break down all the action from Wednesday's NBA season openers from Anthony Edwards' explosive 45-point game with LaMelo Ball and the Timberwolves to Ty Jerome's incredible 45-point outburst against the Jazz. They also react to Giannis' first game with the Heat and share early concerns over Miami's supporting cast.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The pair also unpacks the Warriors' uncertain future, Yaxel Lendeborg's on-court and off-court battles with Luka Doncic, the return of Tyrese Haliburton and Damian Lillard and more.
